data.name: Maqbul
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'maqbul', meaning 'accepted, welcomed, pleasing to Allah'. In Islamic tradition, the name symbolizes the belief that one's actions, prayers, and deeds are accepted by Allah. It also signifies the idea of being welcomed and blessed by Allah in both this world and the next.
data.spiritual_meaning: Name symbolizes the belief that one's actions are accepted by Allah.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Shihab Al-Asqalani's Al-Isaba fi Tamyiz Al-Sahaba, Volume 1, Page 445. The name Maqbul is mentioned in connection with the life of Sayiduna Abu Hurairah (RA), a companion of Prophet Muhammad (SA).
